command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "function Get-Cfg(`$p,`$n){ foreach(`$c in @('display%20current-configuration','show%20running-config')){ `$u=('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/{0}/nodes/{1}/command?cmd={2}' -f `$p,`$n,`$c); try { `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u).output } catch { `$o=`$null }; if(`$o -and -not `$o.StartsWith('Error:')){ return `$o } }; return `$null }; `$nodes=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes'; foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ `$a=Get-Cfg 'CampusNetwork_02' `$n.node_id; `$b=Get-Cfg 'CampusNetwork-for-perf_02' `$n.node_id; if(`$a -and `$b){ `$aa=@(`$a -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object {`$_ -notmatch '^!Last configuration|^Building configuration|^Current configuration'}); `$bb=@(`$b -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object {`$_ -notmatch '^!Last configuration|^Building configuration|^Current configuration'}); `$d=Compare-Object `$bb `$aa -SyncWindow 5; if(`$d){ Write-Output ('### '+`$n.node_id); `$d | Select-Object InputObject,SideIndicator | Format-Table -HideTableHeaders | Out-String -Width 240 | Write-Output } } }"
